title: Move Zeroes
audience: Candidates refreshing a familiar interview pattern
objective: Understand stable in-place compaction using scan and write pointers
constraints: 0 <= n <= 100000; signed 32-bit integers; mutate the same array
callToAction: Save it. Then try the next example.

narration.hook: Zeroes last. Keep other numbers in order.
narration.setup: The scan pointer reads. The write pointer marks the next slot.
narration.zero: Zero. Move only the scan pointer.
narration.swap: Found {value}. Swap it into the waiting slot. Then advance both pointers.
narration.summary: Reading and placing in the same order preserves the sequence. One pass. Constant extra space.
narration.challenge: Your turn. Where does the five belong?
